Eternal Materials.why: Supplies wafer-level liquid molding compound for fan-out / MUF advanced packaging and dry-film photoresist used to image IC-substrate circuits; AI package and substrate volume drives demand for both.
Eternal Materials.evidence: Eternal Materials product pages (retrieved 10-01-2026): EI-6042 wafer-level liquid molding compound for Fan-out (die first / RDL first), SiP and MUF; negative aqueous dry-film photoresist series for IC substrates (HP-3600, LDF, NIT, UDH, APR400).

players.product: Wafer-level liquid molding compound (EI-6042) for fan-out (die-first / RDL-first), SiP and MUF packaging; negative aqueous dry-film photoresist for IC substrates, multilayer PCBs and IC packaging (incl. LDI grades)
